summary: Expand the TypeScript Respan facade auto-discovery path to use a direct LLM instrumentation registry, report known non-direct TypeScript instrumentations as disabled-by-default, include Vertex AI and OpenRouter direct-provider instrumentors, resolve auto-discovered instrumentation and mutable SDK modules from the application runtime, prevent duplicate OpenAI and Azure OpenAI spans when both instrumentors are active, and make OpenRouter installable outside the workspace
